title: The URL Filtering and Cloud App advanced settings resource: import, field names and what an update sends

prose.text: This singleton resource writes every advanced URL and Cloud App setting at once. {{update-is-full-typed-put}} {{v4-8-5-fixed-turn-off}}

prose.label: Resource and data source differ.
prose.text: {{resource-has-google-quillbot}} Platform behavior of the settings themselves: [[zia.url-filtering.advanced-settings]].
What a serialized false does to an enabled setting is open [[zia.url-filtering.advanced-settings:creative-commons-backend-effect]].

checks.do: Whether an HCL attribute uses the provider's own spelling, `enable_per_plexity_prompt`, before reporting the field missing.

import-id-app-setting.statement: `zia_url_filtering_and_cloud_app_settings` is imported with the literal ID `app_setting`, and the importer sets the resource ID to that string.

quotes: can be imported by using `app_setting` as the import ID.

evidence.after: failed to read url filtering and cloud app settings import

perplexity-field-misspelled.statement: The Perplexity prompt-logging attribute is spelled `enable_per_plexity_prompt` in the executable schema, and the resource reads and writes it under that name.

update-is-full-typed-put.statement: Create and update build a typed `URLAdvancedPolicySettings` value from the schema and pass it to `UpdateUrlAndAppSettings`, which sends all the settings rather than a patch of changed ones.

quotes: // URLAdvancedPolicySettings is the full set of advanced URL filtering and cloud
The booleans deliberately omit omitempty: a caller disabling a setting sends

v4-8-5-fixed-turn-off.statement: Provider v4.8.5 fixed this resource rejecting updates with `Request body is invalid.` and being unable to turn a setting back off; updates now carry every supported setting, and `safe_search_apps` is sent only when applications are specified.

quotes: rejected updates with `Request body is invalid.` and could not turn a setting back off.
`safe_search_apps` is sent only when applications are specified.
Updates now carry every supported setting, so disabling one takes effect;

creative-commons-field-has-no-omitempty.statement: The SDK field `EnableCreativeCommonsSearchResults` is tagged `json:"enableCreativeCommonsSearchResults"` with no `omitempty`.

quotes: // body that carries it, so it keeps omitempty and is never sent as false. BlockSkype bool `json:"blockSkype,omitempty"`

creative-commons-only-in-data-source.statement: The provider data source declares `enable_creative_commons_search_results` as a computed attribute and sets it from the API response.

creative-commons-false-serialized.statement: So an update through the resource sends `enableCreativeCommonsSearchResults=false` even though the resource schema never sets it.
creative-commons-false-serialized.conditions: Go serializes a non-omitempty bool as false when the builder leaves it unassigned; the resource file contains no reference to the field (searched).

resource-has-google-quillbot.statement: The resource defines and reads back the Google AI prompt-logging attribute, while the data source defines neither the Google AI nor the QuillBot attributes.
resource-has-google-quillbot.conditions: The absence in the data source file was established by searching it for google_ai and quillbot (no matches at the pin).
